# Auctionator Remastered 1.0.1

A small bug-fix update following the 1.0 release.

- **Correct version notifications:** original Auctionator 3.1.5 no longer appears as a newer version of Auctionator Remastered. Remastered version messages now use a separate channel, with numeric version comparisons. Shopping-list sharing is unchanged.
- **Shopping Planner window order:** opening Shopping lists brings the Planner in front of Offline Browser, including when the Planner is already open.

Saved prices, history, shopping lists and preferences are preserved. The ZIP contains only `AuctionatorRemastered/` and `AuctionatorRemastered_Startup/` at its root. Close WoW, replace both folders, then restart.

[Detailed patch notes](https://github.com/andreash-dev/Auctionator-Remastered-WotLK/blob/main/RELEASE_CHANGELOG.md)
